LIST.TITLE: Discounts
LIST.SUBTITLE: Named discounts applied to invoices, receipts, and POS transactions.
LIST.NAME: Name
LIST.EMPTY: No discounts yet — add one to get started.

FORM.SCOPE_HINT: Optional — leave both lists empty to apply the discount everywhere.
FORM.TYPE_MANUAL_HINT: Cashiers pick this discount manually at the POS.
FORM.TYPE_AUTOMATIC_HINT: Applies automatically inside the scheduled window below.
FORM.TYPE_LOCKED_HINT: Type can't be changed after the discount is saved.
FORM.SCHEDULE_HINT: Window during which the discount applies. Leave the expire date empty to keep it running indefinitely.
FORM.ALL_DAY_HINT: When on, the schedule is date-based only — no start/end time of day.
FORM.EXPIRE_HINT: Optional — leave blank for no end date.
FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.AMOUNT_HINT: Fixed amount in the company currency, or a percentage 0–100.
FORM.QTY_BASED_HINT: When enabled, the fixed amount applies per quantity rather than per line.
FORM.APPLY_SWITCH_TO_PRODUCT_MSG: Switching to products will clear the categories you've picked. Continue?
FORM.APPLY_SWITCH_TO_CATEGORY_MSG: Switching to categories will clear the products you've picked. Continue?
FORM.EMPLOYEES_HINT: Empty = every employee can apply this discount.
FORM.AVAILABLE_HINT: When off, cashiers can't pick this discount at the register.
FORM.AVAILABLE_ONLINE_HINT: When off, the storefront won't apply this discount at checkout.
FORM.ERR_NAME_DUPLICATE: Another discount already uses this name.
FORM.ERR_START_REQUIRED: Automatic discounts need a start date.
FORM.ERR_EXPIRE_BEFORE_START: Expire date can't be before the start date.
